nota: The contract register: the literal `C` holds one record for each signed or unsigned contract (value, beneficiary, signing date, status, approved value, promised localisation, events with their sources), and `F`, `NS`, `ST` and `SCURT` hold the filters, the unsigned projects and short labels. llms.txt says that a CSV with the CUI of each supplier exists on request by e-mail; it is not public, so no CUI field is read.

The derived data file of the governance report (a 150,000-byte range sample). Its top-level keys are `schema`, `built_at`, `source`, `fields`, `authorities`, `companies`, `people`, `appointments`. `fields` declares the names of the positions of the rows of `appointments` (11) and `companies` (12). The body holds the names of members of the boards of state companies (`people`, `appointments`). The source is not marked `persoane`: the plain reader keeps no value for it (88 field records, no key beyond the allowed ones, none of the 1,086 identifying strings of the sample occurs in them), and the mark would make the leak check flag 7 tracked files that hold names of institutions.

The financial history of the state companies, 2016-2025, from the same sources as the governance report (a 150,000-byte range sample). The file keeps the address and the SHA-256 of each original file under `sources`.

The public procurement of the state companies since 2024 (a 150,000-byte range sample): the periods, the rules that the report applied (framework agreements left out, repeated rows, a direct-award ceiling) and the quarterly files that it read, each with its address and SHA-256.
The list of the report channels that the page of reports loads when it opens (one request, 1,378 characters).
The index of the institutions that have reports, loaded by the same page (one request, 5,313 characters).

Data file that the page fetched when the browser rendered it. Data request of the home page: the aggregate counts (total, active, suspended, with a special certificate, by county and by branch). No person.
